title: The Throne in the Clouds
text: Above the sixth shrine a throne of storm sits empty but for the one on it. He offers strength to anyone who will call him king, and asks only that you kneel, and leave a little of yourselves behind.

options.label: Kneel, and pay what it asks.

outcomes.text: The thunder goes into your arms. Something of each of you stays kneeling there when you rise.
It rises from its throne, and it is very much larger standing.

options.label: Take the gift and refuse the price.

outcomes.text: The leader takes the lightning and does not kneel. The Thunderer laughs, and stands.
He sees it coming. The lightning goes the other way.
